GMB.note: No count or share of people enrolled stated.
Cards are for citizens 18 and over; birth certificate is only a required document.
No operator, maintainer or owner of the platform stated beyond the ministry announcing the rollout.
No public register keyed on the ID stated.

facts.fact: Government says registration and issuance of the new Biometric National Identity Card for citizens 18 and over began on 4 August 2026 at seven Greater Banjul centres, with further regions from 7 to 21 September 2026 (Ministry of Interior announcement).

systems.owner: Ministry of Interior; Gambia Immigration Department
